title: Seoul seeks ‘way out’ of Ukraine dispute, denies tilt toward Russia
caption:
A secret prisoner transfer disclosed at the UN caused South Korea to recall its ambassador to Ukraine. Officials in Seoul are now working to resolve the diplomatic rift while maintaining existing sanctions against Russia.
